wasm (Emscripten): same FreeType/HarfBuzz sources as Linux plus a seam that reads the game's own System/Simyou.ttf out of the module filesystem, because there is no fontconfig and a page cannot download a font; web ctest 2/2 and a text.ready session captured from the framebuffer under out/evidence

wasm seam notes: EM_ASM cannot write C++ out-parameters (use setValue); the web preset is MEMORY64 so pointers need Number() in JS; Emscripten FS.readFile returns a Uint8Array for a raw read, and asking for encoding 'binary' silently zeroes every byte

The bitmap compatibility path remains selectable everywhere via [Display] NativeText=False; canvas_compatibility_contracts pins it
